summary: Two Colorado Mountain College Leadville-campus students, Kaden Matsuda, 19, and Jackson Donlon, 20, left campus Friday to climb Ice Mountain in the Collegiate Peaks and did not return as planned; college staff reported them missing Monday morning 2026-10-26. Chaffee County Search and Rescue North and South searched with drones, helicopters, an infrared multi-mission aircraft and search dogs, joined Tuesday by teams from Lake, Teller, Park and Arapahoe counties (~50 searchers); a helicopter spotted their tent near Lake Ann just after noon Tuesday 2026-10-27, collapsed under snow with sleeping bags, a stove and clothing inside but neither hiker present. Heavy snow (1-2 ft on the mountain, 3-4 ft drifted) fell Saturday 2026-10-24 after rain; search ongoing, both unlocated as of Tuesday evening 2026-10-27.
location: Ice Mountain / Lake Ann area, near Winfield
responding_agency: Chaffee County Search and Rescue North and South
notes: Trip departure Fri 2026-10-23 (vehicle found at the Mt. Huron trailhead near Winfield off County Road 390 with ~8 in. of snow around it and none underneath, indicating arrival before the Sat snowfall); reported missing Mon 2026-10-26; tent found Tue 2026-10-27. Source = The Next Summit, reporting from the Chaffee County Sheriff's Office, KRDO and KKTV (article updated Tue 2026-10-27 18:17 MDT). Outcome watch: search ongoing at insert time — update outcome when resolved. Not Kaden Sites (id 1706, Apr 2026 Mt. Shavano hunter) — different person, similar first name; no relation. Distinct from id 3391 (2020 Ice Mountain / Three Apostles missing hiker Terry Pann).
